initial_storage_harness.explanation: All tensor values and DataFrames matched; the initial harness incorrectly required identical storage size. Returning offsets in their consumed int32 dtype permits sharing one 144-byte vector instead of casting it twice. The final harness records this reduction and verifies that default storage does not increase.

limits: Absent families are represented with their actual zero length and native-compatible rank/strides, without dummy tables or offsets.

Whole-pose/block-pair energies and nonuniformly weighted coordinate gradients match the full database restricted to the same lookup rows. Entirely unmapped Dunbrack terms produce zero energies and gradients.
This permits deliberately reduced private databases; it does not automatically prune reference coverage from a full database.

Default nonempty tensor values/dtypes and all three lookup DataFrames match exactly on CPU/CUDA. Storage counts exclude source parameters, Python metadata, allocator overhead and temporary peaks. No timing improvement is claimed.
